name: NeuroForecast v3 development study
status: LOCKED by lock_v3.json (protocol SHA-256 recorded there) before any outer-fold prediction existed
disclosure: Both earlier sealed tests are spent: the 3-date reserve (scored 2026-09-21) and the 28-date external set (scored 2026-09-27). The author has read outcomes on all 45 dates.
This is therefore a development comparison under nested, chemical-purged, batch-grouped cross-validation. It is not a sealed test, and no v3 number may be described as one.
Engineering checks before the lock (code runs, losses fall, training length, model width) used only inner folds of outer fold 0. No outer-fold prediction of any v3 candidate existed before the lock.

Pre-lock engineering checks, all on the 4 inner folds of outer fold 0 (date-macro MAE on its usable cases; persistence 0.981, v2 recipe 0.745, Extra Trees + batch context 0.752, + dose-series context 0.745): PCT 1 seed: d64/L2 0.791, d128/L3 0.764 then 0.783 on a rerun (seed noise ~0.02), + condition features 0.760, d128/L4/200 epochs 0.748, + aux weight 1.0 0.749; 3 seeds: L4 0.772, L4 + aux 1.0 0.753 and 0.747 on a rerun (GPU nondeterminism, removed before the lock), with weight averaging (EMA) 0.750 (not used); a 50/50 blend of the last PCT with the v2 recipe scored 0.713. The ens_v2_pct candidate was declared before that blend was computed.
TabPFN uses the v2 weights (Hollmann et al., Nature 2025), which download without a licence login; later TabPFN versions require an interactive licence acceptance that was not performed.

data.source: USEPA/CompTox-DNT-NFA-Refinement @01adf3e, All_DIV_Data.Rdata (re-processing of the same recordings as the EPA archive; no cv.time/cv.network; adds mi)
data.case: date/identity/dose, identity resolved to DSSTox as in v2; eligibility exactly as v2 (at least two replicate wells with finite day-5 and day-7 reference values, finite day-12 target)
data.target: v2 target: day-12 log2 replicate-mean (ns.n+1)/(same-plate day-12 control median ns.n+1)
data.usable: day-12 plate control median ns.n >= 5 (v2 rule); every score is on usable cases
data.inputs_tabular: the v2 day-5/day-7 feature table plus batch-context descriptors (neuroforecast_v3_data.CONTEXT) and dose-series descriptors of the same batch and chemical (neuroforecast_v3_run.CHEMICAL), all from days 5 and 7 only
data.inputs_pct: per-well day-5 and day-7 readouts of every well of the test batch (controls and treated), well position; no identity, date or plate label
data.labels_pct: condition target; condition-level day-9/day-12 profile (twin); per-well day-9/day-12 readouts (auxiliary). Labels exist only for training dates and never for purged chemicals

evaluation.outer: 9 folds; the 45 sorted dates interleaved (date i -> fold i mod 9)
evaluation.inner: within each outer training set, 4 folds of the sorted training dates interleaved
evaluation.purge: at both levels, every condition (and every PCT label) of any chemical present in the held-out dates is removed from training
evaluation.metric: date-macro MAE on usable cases: absolute error averaged within chemical, then over chemicals within a date, then over dates (as since v1)
evaluation.comparison: paired bootstrap over dates of per-date loss differences, 10000 resamples, seed above

v2_incumbent.note: the shipped v2 recipe (small activity/coordination Extra Trees, frozen hyperparameters)

et_small_chem.note: v2 columns plus dose-series descriptors from the same batch and chemical (days 5 and 7)

pct.note: plate-context transformer; 5-seed ensemble at both levels so inner and outer scores are comparable

selection.nested: in each outer fold, the selectable candidate with the lowest inner date-macro MAE (ties: protocol order) supplies that fold's outer predictions; the pooled result is the nested v3 estimate
selection.final_pick: the selectable candidate with the lowest outer date-macro MAE over all 45 dates; its own outer score is post-selection and descriptive only
selection.ablations: pct_no_context, pct_no_relations and pct_no_aux are reported, never selected

uncertainty.sigma: Extra Trees on |inner out-of-fold residual| of the product (v2 sigma columns + context, plus quantile spread and seed spread when the product is a PCT); cross-fitted over the inner folds for calibration scores
uncertainty.baseline_method: pooled_scaled: split-conformal quantile of |residual|/sigma over all calibration cases (the v2 method)
uncertainty.primary_method: date_scaled: the same scores, each calibration case weighted 1/(cases on its date), so every culture batch counts equally (batch-level exchangeability)
uncertainty.secondary: pooled_cqr and date_cqr: conformalized PCT quantiles (0.1/0.9)
uncertainty.success: date-averaged outer coverage within 0.77-0.83 at nominal 0.80 and within 0.87-0.93 at nominal 0.90

trust: AURC (mean retained MAE over retention 50-100%) of sigma, extremity, predicted change and day-7 magnitude; abstention declines the top 20% of sigma
warning: early-quiet (|day-7|<0.5) conditions with |day-12 target|>=1, 20% budget per date: products' |predicted change| against highest dose and |day-7|
twin: condition-level day-9/day-12 relative activity and control contrast of all 17 readouts; PCT twin head against carrying the day-7 value forward; date-macro MAE on usable cases

swap_rule.description: v3 replaces v2 in the shipped tool only if every check passes; otherwise v2 stays shipped and v3 is reported as a development finding
checks: nested v3 date-macro MAE <= 0.95 x incumbent
paired date-bootstrap 95% interval of (nested v3 - incumbent) entirely below 0
nested v3 better on at least 55% of dates with usable cases
final pick's sigma AURC <= 1.02 x incumbent's
final pick is not the incumbent
swap_rule.deployment: a swapped model must be ported to the browser app and agree with Python within 1e-4 on every outer prediction

reproducibility: PCT runs with torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True) and CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8: reruns are bit-identical on the same GPU, driver and package versions (venv_freeze.txt). Extra Trees, ridge, LightGBM and MLP are single-threaded and seeded.
